Exercise A

Lesen & Erkennen

Lies den Text und wähle für jede Lücke die passende Form.

Bevor du liest

Diese Frage wird nicht bewertet — schreib einfach, was dir einfällt.

Anitas Austauschjahr in Kanada

So funktioniert es: Nach enjoy steht die -ing-Form — „I enjoy travelling." Nach decide steht to + Verb — „I decided to go."

1 When Anita arrived in Toronto, she was nervous about her host family for the first time.

2 After a few shy days, she decided the school swim team.

3 At first she avoided English in class because she was afraid of making mistakes.

4 But her teacher suggested a little every single day.

5 By December, Anita had learned most conversations at school.

6 Now the exchange year is nearly over, and she's looking forward to her Canadian friends again next summer.

Exercise B

Verb + Form

Acht Sätze, acht Verben — wähle für jeden Satz die richtige Form.

Task

1 My little brother enjoys sandcastles at the beach.

2 We want the science museum this weekend.

3 Have you finished your essay yet?

4 She promised me move house next Saturday.

5 The dog kept all night.

6 He refused any of our questions.

7 Would you mind down the music a little?

8 They hope the driving test this time.

Exercise C

Bedeutung ändert sich

Bei remember, stop und try ändert die Form die Aussage — lies jeden Satz genau.

Task

1 I clearly remember him at a conference years ago — I still remember his face.

2 Please remember your passport tomorrow — you can't board without it.

3 On the way home, we stopped some bread.

4 After years of trying, she finally stopped completely.

5 I tried the computer, but it still wouldn't work.

6 We tried him for hours, but he wouldn't change his mind.

Exercise D

Schreiben

Schreib eine E-Mail an deine Austauschpartnerin Emma in Leeds.

Task

Erzähl Emma: worauf du dich freust (look forward to + -ing), was du in der Schule vermeidest zu tun (avoid + -ing), und was du dieses Jahr noch lernen möchtest zu tun (learn + to). Schreib mindestens 6 Sätze und benutze dabei mindestens drei Verben aus dieser Übung.

✅

Geschafft!

Hier ist deine Auswertung. Wenn du möchtest, kannst du unten deine E-Mail-Adresse hinterlassen — Shaun sieht sich deine Antworten dann persönlich an und meldet sich bei dir.
